vocabulary.definition: a young child with exceptional talent in a particular field
vocabulary.example: Mozart was considered a child prodigy in music, composing his first piece at the age of five.

vocabulary.definition: the act of making sense of information received by the brain
vocabulary.example: The brain's processing of visual stimuli differs between artists and non-artists.

vocabulary.definition: the general understanding of something without focusing on the details
vocabulary.example: Even though she didn't catch every word, she got the gist of the conversation.

vocabulary.definition: useful pieces of advice or recommendations
vocabulary.example: He gave me some tips on how to improve my painting technique.

vocabulary.definition: to be extremely impressed or surprised
vocabulary.example: The audience was blown away by the artist's incredible performance.

vocabulary.definition: capable of being taught or trained
vocabulary.example: Mike believes that artistic skills are trainable and not solely based on innate talent.
